title: NFP Quiz: Do You Know Where Price REALLY Goes First? 🧠📊
description: It's NFP Friday — June 2026. Before you touch a single trade today, can you answer this one question? Most traders get it wrong... and blow their accounts because of it. Test yourself with the R2F Trading NFP quiz and find out if you actually understand what smart money does during high-impact news. Follow r2ftrading.com for daily ICT breakdowns.
script: It's NFP Friday. One question. Most funded traders get this right. Most beginners blow up getting it wrong. Let's find out which one you are. Question: Right before NFP drops — where does price go FIRST on 82% of releases? Is it: A — straight up toward buyside liquidity. B — straight down toward sellside liquidity. C — it sweeps liquidity FIRST, then reverses. If you said A or B — that's the trap. Smart money doesn't move straight. It hunts stops first. The answer is C. Price sweeps the liquidity pool — grabs your stop — THEN makes the real move. The R2F Trading system teaches you to WAIT for the sweep. Enter after the grab. That's how funded traders survive NFP.
